page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.2xlarge is an instance in the High Clock Speed family built on KVM virtualization. It features a dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon 8369HB processor running at 3.3 GHz. The configuration allocates 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs via 2 threads per core, backed by 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 33 MB shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, AVX-512 VNNI, and AVX-512 BF16. Memory capacity is 64.0 GB, delivering 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU, with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps. The instance provides no bundled local storage and includes zero GPUs.

Benchmark data positions the instance consistently within the middle 50% across general compute and memory tests. In synthetic CPU tests, it recorded a stress-ng single-core score of 1576.69 and multi-core score of 8306.57, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 9658.56 and Geekbench scores of 1320.0 single-core and 5074.0 multi-core. Large-block memory bandwidth reached 51.09 GB/sec read and 38.89 GB/sec write. In-memory data store performance achieved 7.99 million Redis SET operations per second, while static web serving throughput measured 7.65 GB/sec.

Performance constraints emerge on larger model processing due to the absence of dedicated hardware acceleration. While prompt processing on a small 135M model achieved 535.72 tokens/sec, medium 7B model prompt processing dropped to 11.93 tokens/sec (bottom 10%) and text generation reached 6.39 tokens/sec (bottom 25%). Furthermore, workloads requiring non-volatile local storage require network-attached block volumes.

With an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio and high single-core frequency, the ecs.hfr7.2xlarge offers balanced resource density for memory-sensitive enterprise applications. It is appropriate for relational and in-memory databases, software compilation, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise backends that do not require specialized GPU acceleration.
